content:
Apple has redesigned the Apple Pay checkout experience in apps and websites with iOS 27. The changes make it easier for users to switch between different payment cards and clearly see important information about their orders.

In iOS 27, users can now switch between payment cards by swiping directly on the Apple Pay main interface. They can also tap on a card to view all available Apple Pay cards at once in a grid layout.

Apple states:

Merchants and developers can control what appears on the Apple Pay payment sheet, depending on the specific information needed to complete an order.

The Apple Pay checkout experience in iOS 26 had long been criticized for being unintuitive. For example, users often tapped the wrong thing when trying to switch payment cards. Intuitively, tapping the card itself should switch it, but in iOS 26 this only took you to the address editing screen. To actually switch to another card, you had to tap a separate button at the bottom. iOS 27 simplifies all of these actions, making the flow much clearer.

What do you think of the new Apple Pay interface in apps and websites on iOS 27? Share your thoughts in the comments.
